registration_basis: B7 source-anchored witness RG-PUB-01 plus runtime consumer inventory inspected 2026-10-24
scope_addendum: Split interaction execution into a lower REL execution core and an upper public InteractionRuntime binding; the original interaction child remains open until this cut and preserving evidence are complete.

witnesses.evidence: InteractionRuntime stores Cva, invokes its ingest/materialize/finalize operations, and exposes cva()/into_cva(); the public facade extension accesses the same field.

REL workers, session/background operations, stream persistence, and publication logic use InteractionRuntime and/or its Cva field, so moving only its declaration would leave the runtime capability edge.

cut: Define the concrete REL mounted execution owner in owner_lifecycle. Store it in a lower RelExecution core used by workers. Keep InteractionRuntime as the upper public adapter, preserving new(Cva), cva(), into_cva(), and all currently exposed interaction methods via the core binding. No duplicate owner state.
preserving_contracts: public InteractionRuntime API and Cva transfer/access behavior
turn receipt, replay idempotency, and sync acknowledgement
single mounted REL writer and current queue/publication ordering
limits: The consumer inventory is bounded source inspection, not compiler-resolved call closure.
No source changes or behavior checks are represented by this registration.
